affirmative_observations: Single initial-equity denominator gives all objective terms return-fraction units.
Terminal liquidation cost is separate from immediate cash and past entry costs are sunk.
Immediate buy funding uses pre-sale cash minus pending cash, excluding receivables.
Return covariance and covariance of the mean error remain distinct.
Calendar schedule shadow requires retained/new positions to have an executable exit at common horizon within original deadline.
Partial-fill corner enumeration includes fixed-order-fee and zero-inventory discontinuities.

findings.observed: A 20-second quote and 170/171-hour model/labels were accepted after raising configurable maxima to 60 seconds/336 hours.
findings.required_change: New allocator settings must not relax 15-second quote and 168-hour model/latest-label contracts.
